mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right color and pattern for my pool tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right color and pattern involves considering your home's architectural style, existing landscaping, and personal aesthetic preferences. Lighter tiles typically make the water appear a brighter blue, while darker tiles can create a deeper, more reflective lagoon-like effect. Patterns can range from classic mosaics to contemporary geometric designs. We recommend looking at samples under different lighting conditions and considering how the tile will complement your surrounding outdoor living areas. Our design consultants can guide you through the options, helping you visualize the final outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your home's style, landscaping, and personal preferences. Lighter tiles brighten water, darker tiles deepen it. View samples and consult with our designers to choose.
